title: Image to Text - OCR, Word Coordinates & 图片文字识别
description: Minimal input: {"imageUrls": ["https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tesseract-ocr/test/main/testing/phototest.tif"], "language": "eng"}. One paid row per nonempty image.

imageUrls.title: imageUrls
imageUrls.description: Public image URLs, e.g. the prefilled Tesseract sample. Up to 100; 12 MB and 20 million pixels each. One billed row per nonempty OCR image.

language.title: language
language.description: "eng" (default), "chi_sim" for simplified Chinese or "eng+chi_sim" for mixed text. Not automatic detection. Language selection has no extra fee.

maxResults.title: maxResults
maxResults.description: Maximum paid rows across the run, 1–1000, default 20. Example: 3 for a sample. Exclusions and empty results apply before the cap.

excludeIds.title: excludeIds
excludeIds.description: Prior output id values to skip before billing, up to 5,000. Empty [] disables. Suppresses that identity even if content changed.

excludeContentHashes.title: excludeContentHashes
excludeContentHashes.description: Prior output content_hash values (64 lowercase hex characters), up to 5,000. Empty [] disables. Matching snapshots are skipped before billing.
